promptBrief: 方向 C「深夜信号」：功能骨架 + 强品牌氛围，无立绘，聊天气泡纹理 + 霓虹光晕 + 状态位 chibi 贴纸
generationPrompt:
WEB PAGE SECTION DESIGN — this must look like a REAL rendered desktop application screenshot, NOT a poster, NOT an illustration.
The image should look exactly like what you'd see if you opened a beautifully designed dark-mode desktop voice-input app — a functional tool skeleton wrapped in a strong neon brand atmosphere.

Section type: desktop app UI direction board — one settings window showing the 游戏适配 page plus one floating voice-input widget, shown together on a dark canvas
Design style: middle-ground direction — functionalist tool structure with a strong branded atmosphere; no character key art; brand is carried by texture, neon glow and small chibi status stickers only.

CONTENT (render as real readable UI text in Chinese, NOT as decorative lettering):
一个深色（#1A1A2E）桌面设置窗口界面：
- 左侧窄导航栏，顶部一个 Kotone 小圆形头像 logo，导航项自上而下：通用 / 快捷键 / 引擎与模型 / 游戏适配 / 历史记录 / 关于，当前激活项为「游戏适配」（青色辉光高亮）
- 右侧内容区为「游戏适配」设置页：页面标题「游戏适配」使用青 #00E5FF → 品红 #FF2D78 渐变强调；游戏列表卡片（League of Legends、Valorant、Apex Legends、原神，每张卡片带游戏图标与开关 toggle），以及选中游戏的发送快捷键配置区（显示 Ctrl+Enter 的快捷键输入框、「聊天框模式」下拉选择框、品红色「测试发送」按钮）
- 内容区下方有一个「历史记录」空状态卡片：一个趴在桌上睡觉的 Q 版 chibi Kotone 小贴纸 + 文字「还没有语音记录」
设置窗口旁边一个语音输入悬浮窗：
- 青 #00E5FF → 品红 #FF2D78 渐变色的声波波形
- 识别文字框为聊天气泡造型，文字「对面打野在下路草丛，准备来抓」
- 品红 #FF2D78 圆形发送按钮
- 悬浮窗旁有一个发送成功小气泡「收到，已发送！✨」，配一个得意表情的 Q 版 chibi Kotone 贴纸（闭眼竖大拇指）

CHARACTER: no mid-shot or full-body character illustration anywhere. The only character presence is: (1) the tiny circular Kotone avatar logo at the top of the left navigation rail, and (2) two small chibi stickers of the same character as the reference image, appearing only in status spots — one sleeping on a desk in the 历史记录 empty state, one smug thumbs-up next to the success bubble. Everything else is UI.

TEXTURE: all window surfaces carry a low-opacity chat-bubble outline texture — faint rounded speech-bubble contours subtly tiled across the dark background, never interfering with text readability.

COLOR PALETTE: base #1A1A2E deep blue-black, accent #00E5FF neon cyan, #FF2D78 magenta for key CTAs and gradient ends, #7B2FFF purple in gradients and ambient glow. Cyan-to-magenta gradients are used for section headings like 「游戏适配」 and for the waveform.

VISUAL LANGUAGE: neon glow as structural language — thin cyan glowing divider lines between sections, cyan glow on active states, soft luminous card edges; rounded panels, clean sans-serif Chinese typography with clear h1 > h2 > body hierarchy; functional grid layout identical in spirit to a pure tool UI, elevated by glow and texture.

CRITICAL RULES:
- This must look like a PIXEL-PERFECT application render, with proper CSS-like layout: flexbox alignment, grid spacing, consistent padding
- All text must be SHARP, READABLE, and properly typeset — Chinese UI text rendered accurately, like real app typography, not poster lettering
- Chibi stickers must match the character in the reference image, cel-shaded anime style
- Include realistic UI elements: navigation rail, toggle switches, dropdown, input field, buttons, cards, icons, dividers as appropriate for a settings window
- The overall composition should be balanced and professional — branded but never cluttered
- Do NOT add an OS title bar, OS window chrome, watermark, "mockup" label, or "design by" credit around the design
- The image IS the app screen — edge to edge, no frame, no margin
- OUTPUT MUST LOOK LIKE A REAL APPLICATION SCREENSHOT — not a poster, not an illustration
- Texture stays subtle, woven into surfaces — never dominant, never harming readability
notes: Gate 1 方向板 C。与 A 的差异（气泡纹理/光晕/渐变标题/chibi 状态贴纸）与 B 的差异（无立绘）均一眼可辨；chibi 与 foundation 角色一致；文字可读性良好。
